text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week and I pay a visit to a local
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hrrrmmm!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you noticed? Actually, things
have been
kinda... strange for me lately.
choice_data_list: You're praying with some serious intensity.
You're praying with some serious intensity, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm having nightmares, my shoelaces
keep coming
undone—stuff like that. I've
been nothing but
unlucky lately...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So I figure my only choice is to pray!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please send me good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week appears to seriously be
troubled.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Thank you! I'm sure this will be
more
effective than if I pray on my own!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pray with Special Week for good
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should do it! Now then,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzz, bzzz.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, it's an email from my mom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I can't believe it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mom's gonna send me some delicious
crab!
Hehe, it looks like we've already
been blessed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The timely blessing puts Special Week in
good
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrmmm! Phew... Okay, that should do
it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're done praying, let's head
ba—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Coo! Coo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Gross! Did that pigeon just poop
on me?!
T-trainer, heeelp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Unfortunately, it seems like Special
Week's luck
has run out.
